projection: 2:1 dimetric, orthographic, camera elevation 30 deg: one ground metre is pxPerMetre wide along screen x and half of that along screen y
aimZero: frame 0 aims along grid +x (screen lower-right); frames advance with atan2(dy, dx) in grid cells, i.e. clockwise on screen
sheets: towers/<model>_L<level>@1x.json or @2x.json (PixiJS spritesheet); draw <base> first, then <aim>_NN on top, both at the tower's ground point

fire.frameForAim: DD = Math.round(aim / (2 * Math.PI / dirs)) mod dirs, two digits
fire.use: on a shot draw the frames of direction DD instead of the aim layer (base stays); frames 1..releaseFrame-1 at fps, the round leaves at releaseFrame (muzzle point), play on to reloadFrom-1, then spread reloadFrom..frames over the reload time; after the last frame show the aim layer again

field.note: seamless in both screen directions; draw as a tiling sprite at the same pxPerMetre as the towers

road.note: seamless in both screen directions; draw as a tiling sprite at the same pxPerMetre as the towers

drone.shadow: no shadow in the sprite: draw a dark ellipse on the ground below it

airship.shadow: no shadow in the sprite: draw a dark ellipse on the ground below it

enemiesNote: enemies/<model>@1x|@2x.json: frame <model>_NN faces game angle NN * 2*pi/directions (atan2(dy, dx) in grid cells, 0 = screen lower-right); anchor = the unit's ground centre; shadow included

muzzle_flash.note: flame points along +x: rotate the sprite to the barrel's screen angle

fire_stream.note: jet along +x from the nozzle: rotate to the nozzle's screen angle, scale x to the range; loop while firing

fire_burn.note: flames on a burning target or ground patch; loop

rail_charge.note: charging glow at the muzzle; loop while charging

rail_beam.note: shot line along +x from the muzzle: rotate to the target, scale x to the distance; play once

ballista.note: one frame per flight heading (frame = round(angle / (2pi / frames)) mod frames), no shadow: draw a dark ellipse on the ground below it

scorpion.note: one frame per flight heading (frame = round(angle / (2pi / frames)) mod frames), no shadow: draw a dark ellipse on the ground below it

trebuchet.note: tumbling round, no shadow: draw a dark ellipse on the ground below it
